name: Two-day Public Feed HGB
source: ESA Collision Avoidance Challenge, feed-compatible feature subset

crosswalk.latest_time_to_tca: SOCRATES TCA minus current time, days
crosswalk.latest_miss_distance: SOCRATES minimum range converted to metres
crosswalk.latest_relative_speed: SOCRATES relative speed converted to metres per second

warning: The score ranks analyst review priority. It is not a collision probability or manoeuvre command.
